item.tib: bder gshegs rig 'dzin dgongs pa kun 'dus 'chi med gsang ba sum dril gyi rgyud las ma cig bka' gsang lha mo'i bskul pa
item.coloph: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin o rgyan gar dbang rat+na gling pas chu sprel zla ba'i tshes bco lngar spyan drangs te slar rigs ldan bla grwa du mas bskul ngor / chu bya zla bzhi'i tshes dgu la shog ser las zhal bshus shing drung yig tshul khrims blo ldan nas bgyis pas gsang chen bstan pa rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
